objective.subject: docs: fix supersession links and stale references from review
objective.body:
Adversarial review round 1 of the TaskType and workload-fit removal:
run remove-workload-fit-tasktype-07f83919-20261125-025147-d740ff (kimi,
kimi-code/k3.1-pro) and run
remove-workload-fit-tasktype-07f83919-20261125-025348-8fcc7b (codex,
magpie deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro). Kiro (gpt-5.6-terra) was blocked:
kiro-cli is not logged in. Each finding was reproduced against the
working tree and retained at P3:

- kimi:0: ADR 0016's Supersedes line named only ADR 0008 and ADR 0010,
  while ADR 0001 and ADR 0005 name ADR 0016 as a partial successor, so
  the links ran in one direction only. Supersedes now also names the
  TaskType declaration in ADR 0001 (its decision rule and L1 row) and in
  ADR 0005 rule 10.
- kimi:1: ADR 0008 said API and options section 3.2.1 was retired, but
  the section is live as Admission diagnostics and keeps the
  inert-refusal warning and log delivery. The dated note and the closing
  paragraph of the decision now say that only the screening contract and
  the TaskType clauses were retired, and link the live section.
- codex:0: the Unreleased Changed entry on diagnostic strings still
  described the count-only rendering of WorkloadFitReport, which the
  same release removes. The clause is deleted.

No executable file changed. check-adr.py, check-doc-refs.py,
check-local-links.py, and check-english-docs.py pass.
